effects.description: (5 items) While in combat, casting abilities that leave an effect on the ground will create a circle of healing frost for |cffffff10|r seconds. You and your group members restore |cffffff1125|r Health every |cffffff2|r seconds while inside the circle. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina.
